en.hubeali:
From him, from Ibn Fazzal, from Musa Al Hannat, from Abu Asama, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Said: “Had it not been for Myazwj Momin servant finding (sadness) in his heart, Iazwj would have Head-banded the heads of the disbelievers with an iron headband so his head would never (get) hurt, ever’.
en.sarwar: 24. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from ibn Faddal from Muthanna al-Hannat from abu ‘Usamah from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, has said, ‘Had my believing servant not felt sadness in his heart, I would have wrapped up the head of the unbelievers for protection with iron wrapping material so he would never experience any headaches.’”
